title: Forget all the C'of the 21 century We call this community Talk of soft skills Reflection of societal ills Want a woekforce? Right the course Invest in
summary: Forget all the C'of the 21 century We call this community Talk of soft skills Reflection of societal ills Want a woekforce? Right the course Invest in local, only focal point To ever rock the joint #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Forget all the C'of
the 21 century
We call this community
Talk of soft skills
Reflection of societal ills
Want a woekforce?
Right the course
Invest in local, only focal point
To ever rock the joint
#smallpoems
